六元超图的 Property B 下界：m(6)≥67

1. 原命题与证明结构

定义1.1。 有限简单六元超图是二元组 H=(V,E)，其中 V 有限，E 是互不相同的六元顶点子集组成的集合。它具有 Property B，是指存在 χ:V→{红,蓝}，使每条原边同时含两种颜色。m(6) 是不具有 Property B 的有限简单六元超图的最少边数。

目标命题T67。 每个有限简单六元超图若满足 |E|≤66，便具有 Property B；等价地，m(6)≥67。

证明性质。 本文给出覆盖任意有限简单六元超图的计算机辅助证明。选点、度数分流与概率充分条件均有数学证明；有限计算仅用于完整局部迹类型的精确有理不等式，全部实际使用域另有独立重建与概率复算。本文尚无 Lean 形式化。数学与数值证据分别列于第9节，最终审阅另见审计记录。

定义1.2。 记 Pv 为下述内部命题：任意恰有 v 个顶点、恰有66条边、覆盖每个不同顶点对的有限简单六元超图都具有 Property B。

主定理1.3。 任意有限简单六元超图，若边数至多66，则具有 Property B。因此 m(6)≥67。

证明先将假定反例归约为27–44点、恰66边的点对覆盖超图，再用第6、7节逐支建立全部 Pv，最后回到原染色。主定理不要求原输入预先满足点对覆盖、度数、顶点数或证书假设。

全文记

d(x)=|{A∈E:x∈A}|,λxy=|{A∈E:{x,y}⊆A}|.

下文的点对覆盖、度数及锁点条件都在同一个实际反例内部推出，不作为原目标的附加条件。

2. 从任意原始反例到27–44点

引理2.1。 若T67为假，则存在一个不具有 Property B 的简单六元超图，满足

(2.1)27≤v≤44,|E|=66,∑xd(x)=396,d(x)≥⌈v−15⌉,λxy≥1 (x≠y).

证明。 在边数至多66的所有反例中选顶点数最少者。若不同点 x,y 从不同时属于一条边，则将其识别。每条边仍有六个不同像点，重复像边仅保留一次。所得简单六元超图的边数不增加，任何合法染色拉回都会染好原超图，所以所得仍是反例，违背顶点数最小性。故原反例覆盖每个点对。

对每个点求共度和，得到

5d(x)=∑y≠xλxy≥v−1,

进而 v⌈(v−1)/5⌉≤6|E|≤396。该整数函数非减，而 45⌈44/5⌉=405>396，故 v≤44；端点44不能遗漏，因为 44⌈43/5⌉=396。

当 v≤10，把顶点分成两个大小均至多五的颜色类即可。当 11≤v≤26，均匀选大小为 ⌊v/2⌋ 的红色类。固定六元边单色的概率为

p(v)=(⌊v/2⌋6)+(⌈v/2⌉6)(v6).

完整十六个整数的精确值如下；每行同时适用于所列两个点数。

v66p(v)
11,121/7
13,144/13
15,166/13
17,18132/221
19,20231/323
21,22264/323
23,24396/437
25,26792/805

各值小于一，故并集界给出没有单色边的染色，排除这些点数。上述直接有理计算由 base_domain_check.py 独立执行并保存在 BASE_DOMAIN_CHECK.json。

此时 27≤v≤44，且 (v6)≥66。若原边数不足66，补入不同的新六元边直至恰66条。补边不改变顶点集，保持点对覆盖及不可二染。以后全部度数、共度及边迹均指这个补边后的同一实际超图，于是得到(2.1)。∎

3. 原染色算法及可计算的严格充分条件

本节复用并重述 六元66下界证明 第3节的机制；该机制本身不依赖总边数65。此处所有边重数之和一律为66。

定义3.1。 固定不同实际锁点 S=(x0,…,xs−1) 及不同位置 p0,…,ps−1∈{1,…,v}，将其余 N=v−s 个实际顶点均匀排列在其余位置。对指标子集 T⊆{0,…,s−1}，令 ℓT 为恰含这些锁点的实际边数，rT=6−|T|。因此 ℓT≥0、∑TℓT=66。

引理3.2（失败见证）。 按给定排列初始全部染红，依次处理顶点；当前点若是一条当前全红边的最后点，便改蓝。最终没有红色单色边。若存在蓝色单色边，则有不同原边 A,B 及点 z，使

(3.1)A∩B={z},z 是 A 的最后点和 B 的最早点.

证明。 最终全红边的最后点在处理时必会改蓝，矛盾。若 B 最终全蓝，取其最早点 z；z 改蓝时有一条仍全红且在此结束的边 A。A∖{z} 全在 z 前，B∖{z} 全在 z 后，故交点唯一。∎

定义3.3。 在位置 h，记 ah,bh 为前、后自由位置数，Ih−,Ih+ 为前、后锁指标集。eh(T),fh(T) 是一条实际 T 型边在 h 结束、开始的条件概率；wh(T,U) 是固定有序单交原边对、类型为 T,U 时形成(3.1)且共同点在 h 的概率。

自由位置上的精确公式为

eh(T)=rT(ahrT−1)N(N−1rT−1),fh(T)=rT(bhrT−1)N(N−1rT−1),

分别要求 T⊆Ih−、T⊆Ih+ 及 rT≥1，其余为零；并有

(3.2)wh(T,U)=(ahrT−1)(bhrU−1)N(N−1rT−1)(N−rTrU−1),

要求 T⊆Ih−、U⊆Ih+、rT,rU≥1、rT+rU−1≤N，否则为零。

若 h=pj，则

eh(T)=(ahrT)(NrT),fh(T)=(bhrT)(NrT),

要求 j∈T 且其余锁点分别全在前、后；并有

(3.3)wh(T,U)=(ahrT)(bhrU)(NrT)(N−rTrU),

要求 T∩U={j}、T∖{j}⊆Ih−、U∖{j}⊆Ih+、rT+rU≤N，否则为零。超出二项式容量的取值为零。

这些公式按“固定共同点占位，再放前方及后方互不相同顶点”的条件抽样直接得到，完整推导见所引第3节引理3.2。定义

Ah=∑TℓTeh(T),Bh=∑TℓTfh(T),Ch=∑T,UℓT(ℓU−1T=U)wh(T,U).

Ch 给全部不同有序边对赋非负记账权；实际非单交对不会成为失败见证，其虚记权可以依法扣除。

引理3.4。 若锁点位置有合法非负扣除量 Dh，不大于该位置实际非单交边对的总记账权；自由位置取 Dh=0，则

(3.4)Pr(失败)≤U:=∑h=1vmin{Ah,Bh,Ch−Dh}.

特别地，U<1 给出原超图的一份合法染色。

证明。 位置 h 的见证事件分别蕴含某边结束、某边开始，以及某个实际有序单交边对的见证。三次并集界分别给出括号中的三个上界。再按位置求并集界并用引理3.2。条件排列空间是实际有限顶点的非空均匀空间；失败概率小于一意味着至少一份排列成功，其贪心输出逐条染好当前实际全部66条边，也就染好补边前的每条原边。∎

4. 同一实际坏对的三种扣除

引理4.1（链接配额及共同向量）。 固定锁 j，取经过它而避开锁指标集 R 的实际边，数目为 fj,R。删去该锁后，得到至多 v−1−|R| 点上的不同五元集合。若其中有 Q 个相交无序集合对，则

5fj,R≤v−1−|R|+4Q,

因为每点重数 a 满足 a≤1+(a2)，不同五元集合的交至多四点。因此可取

(4.1)qj,R=max(0,⌈5fj,R−(v−1−|R|)4⌉).

令 zTU 为含锁 j 的无序迹型格内实际非单交原边对数，容量为 cTT=(ℓT2)、cTU=ℓTℓU。同一个实际向量满足每项约束

0≤zTU≤cTU,∑(T∪U)∩R=∅zTU≥qj,R.

其目标权为 ∑{T,U}[wpj(T,U)+wpj(U,T)]zTU。在这些约束下取整数最小值，即得合法的共同配额扣除 Djjoint。也可对每项 R 单独按权重填足 qj,R，得 Dj,R，再用

Djmax=maxRDj,R≤Djjoint.

证明。 实际向量同时满足全部容量与下界，所以其目标不小于共同最小值，也不小于每个单项最小值及其最大值。不同 R 的扣除不相加；固定位置上每个实际坏对只记一次。∎

引理4.2（组件加强）。 对 f 个不同五元集合、支撑至多 N，建立集合相交图。其一个连通分量有 t 个集合、e 条相交边，则独立数至少

a(t,e)=max(⌈t2t+2e⌉,⌈2t−e−12⌉).

分量支撑至少 5a(t,e)；t≥2 时还至少六。若 e<(t2)−⌊t/2⌋，分量支撑还至少十一。

证明。 第一独立数界由随机排列独立集期望及Cauchy–Schwarz得到。第二界固定一棵生成树，删除至多 e−t+1 个点以击中各非树边，余图为森林；较大二分部给该界。独立顶点对应互不相交的五元集合。两个不同五元集合的并至少六。若支撑至多十，每个五元集合至多有一个不交伙伴（恰十点时只有其补集），故相交图的补图为匹配，非边数至多 ⌊t/2⌋，给最后断言。∎

不同相交分量的支撑互不相交。设 u(t,e) 为上述全部适用支撑界的最大值，另取 u(1,0)=5。递推

S(0,q)=0,S(f,q)=min1≤t≤f, t−1≤e≤min(q,(t2)){u(t,e)+S(f−t,q−e)}

给出至多 q 个相交对时的必要支撑下界。因此

q∗(f,N)=min{q≥0:S(f,q)≤N}

是合法相交对下界，可用于引理4.1中的每个实际避锁池。递推按一个实际分量归纳即证明；允许没有实现图的参数只会使下界更弱。完整证明与输入表分别见 small31_33/REPORT.md 和 CERTIFICATE.json，独立组件及配额核查见 independent31_33/REVIEW.md。

5. 实际选锁与迹覆盖工具

引理5.1（整数低度单位锁）。 令 δ=⌈(v−1)/5⌉，L={x:d(x)≤D}，

Z=(D+1)v−396>0,Q=maxδ≤d≤D(5d−v+2)(D+1−d).

若 Z>(s−1)Q，存在 s 名度至多 D、两两共度一的实际锁点。

证明。 在 L 上以共度至少二连冲突边。点 x 的冲突度至多 5d(x)−(v−1)。随机排列独立集期望至少

∑x∈L15d(x)−v+2≥∑x∈L(D+1−d(x))Q≥Z/Q>s−1.

分母为正，独立数为整数，故至少 s；点对覆盖把独立性变为共度恰一。∎

本稿尾部调用为 (v,D,s;Z,Q)=(39,10,3;33,16),(40,10,4;44,14),(41,10,5;55,12)。42–44点使用下文更直接的九度计数。

引理5.2（实际最小邻点）。 取实际最小度点 x，d=d(x)，令 n=2(v−1)−5d>0。在其实际单位共度邻点中选最低度点 y，度数 e，则

d≤e≤d+⌊396−vdn⌋.

令 t=n−1−(5e−v+1)。若 t>0，在两者实际共同单位邻点中可选最低度点 z，度数 f，满足

e≤f≤e+⌊396−vd−n(e−d)t⌋.

证明。 第一实际单位池大小 r≥n，其中全体度至少 e，故 396≥vd+r(e−d)。共同单位池大小至少 r−1−(5e−v+1)≥t，且它在第一池内。选其最低度点后，396≥vd+n(e−d)+t(f−e)。∎

引理5.3（指定单位边的弱楔）。 若实际 R⊆V，|R|=r，a,b∈R，λab=1 且

5(d(a)+d(b))<2v+2r−6,

则有 z∈R∖{a,b}，使三个点对共度全一，或恰一个为二、另两个为一。

证明。 若不存在，记 ua,ub 为两点在 R 中的单位邻点数。b 的每个除 a 外单位邻点都与 a 共度至少三，且不是 a 的单位邻点。因此

5d(a)≥v−r+2(r−1)−ua+ub−1.

交换 a,b 后相加，得到 5(d(a)+d(b))≥2v+2r−6，矛盾。∎

引理5.4（三锁扩第四锁）。 对三个实际锁 S，令度和 T、内部共度超额 L=∑{x,y}⊂S(λxy−1)，并令

E=5T−3(v−1)−2L,p=v−3−⌊E/2⌋.

若 p>0，可选实际第四锁，其到原三点的共度全一或恰一个二，且度数在

δ≤d4≤δ+⌊396−T−(v−3)δp⌋,

其中 δ 是实际最小度。

证明。 向外共度超额总和正是 E，故至少 p 名外点的总超额至多一。外点总度超额为 396−T−(v−3)δ，对这至少 p 名点取平均。∎

引理5.5（实际迹分类）。 固定实际锁集及其全部点对的共度。每条至少含两锁的原边诱导一个锁子集块 B，其重数 mB 满足

∑B⊇{i,j}mB=λij.

全部非负整数解覆盖全部实际多锁迹；单锁迹由实际度数减去多锁贡献，空迹由66减去非空总数。扩锁时必须把新多重块限制到旧锁集后，恢复旧的完整多重块集。

证明。 每个实际点对恰被其共度条原边包含，故给上述等式；后两项由度数及边数定义给出。按剩余点对容量递归枚举允许团块，终点为零容量，按总剩余容量归纳覆盖每个非负解。共度全一时这是 Ks 的团划分，s=3,4,5 的完整带标签型数分别为2、6、32。本文只枚举有限锁迹，不枚举原超图。∎

6. 二十七至三十三点及三十六至四十四点

6.1 二十七至三十点：零锁

引理6.1。 P27,P28,P29,P30 成立。

证明。 记 Q 为不同无序原边对中交至少二者的数目。点对覆盖给

10Q≥∑{A,B}(|A∩B|2)=∑{x,y}(λxy2)≥990−(v2).

第一步用不同六元边交至多五；最后一步用 (a2)≥a−1 和全部共度和 66(62)=990。故取 q(v)=⌈(990−(v2))/10⌉，实际有序单交边对至多 γ(v)=66⋅65−2q(v)。零锁时每个固定有序单交对在 h 的权相同，得到

U0(v)=∑hmin{396(h−15)v(v−15),396(v−h5)v(v−15),γ(v)(h−15)(v−h5)v(v−15)(v−65)}.

四项完整精确结果为

vq(v)γ(v)U0(v)
276441621491391/1560090
28624166794453/825930
295941722365165/2395197
30564178179971/180090

均严格小于一。新独立短程序及全部结果见 BASE_DOMAIN_CHECK.json。引理3.4产生原染色。∎

6.2 三十一至三十三点

引理6.2。 P31,P32,P33 成立。

证明。 全文实际选点证明、每个完整度数区间及迹式见 small31_33/REPORT.md，本文说明覆盖接口。

31点实际最小度为6–12。6–11用一锁；最小度12时至少七名十二度点，固定其中一人，其余六人若共度均至少七就消耗至少36共度超额，超过实际30，故选十二度二锁且共度1–6。全部十二型严格。

32点最小度7–11按引理5.2选实际单位伙伴，全35型严格。最小度12时有至少20名十二度点；若有其中单位对直接用通过型，若有十二度点到十四至二十四度的单位伙伴，也用通过型。否则这些低点的全部单位邻点都是十三度，至多12人。若没有十三度中心、十二度端点且端点共度至多二的单位楔，单位二部图每条边 rb 都满足 tb<ur。对边求和 1/tb>1/ur 就得十三度邻点数大于十二度点数，矛盾。该四种真实弱楔迹均严格。此支合计51型。

33点最小度7–12按引理5.2选最低度单位伙伴；除 (d,e)=(9,14),(10,14),(11,14) 外，全25型严格。第一例全部单位伙伴至少十四度：度预算迫使恰十九名单位伙伴，并在外部留下至少另一名九度点；其实际共度必为二。该单型以 101147/103385 严格。后两例度预算分别保证至少四、三名十四度单位伙伴，取其中两名，互相共度为1–14、三重交为0或1，共各27种非负实际迹，全部严格。

完整143型保存在 CERTIFICATE.json，最大 163866331/163881900<1。独立重建参数域、125项组件配额表及独立注入概率复算全部143行通过，见 independent31_33/REVIEW.md 和 CHECK.json。所以每个实际输入都到达引理3.4。∎

6.3 三十六至三十八点

引理6.3。 P36,P37,P38 成立。

证明。 完整证明见 PROOF36_38.md。36点最小度7–9用引理5.2，全部到严格二锁或三锁。最小度10时实际度至多12的点集至少24人；最低度点可选此集中一名单位伙伴，其度和至多22，满足引理5.3的 110<114。因而实际弱楔落在全部48种 (10,e,f)、10≤e≤f≤12 型中；29型直接严格，余19型由引理5.4完全延展为3048型，全部严格。最小度11时恰十一正则，取 R=V 用引理5.3；单位三锁迹直接严格，余两种弱楔迹经第四锁完整延展为31型，全部严格。

55≥66−ux+tz−1,tz≤ux−10.

只对正度边求倒数和，得到

a≥∑xz1tz≥∑x∈Rux−cux−10≥rab−10.

分支证明全文

下列附录在本页内收入各实际分支的完整证明，不需跳转 Markdown 才能阅读。附录保留各稿形成时的状态说明；当前完整原题与验收范围以本卷首部及正文第9节为准。

A1 · 31–33点：完整分流与组件配额

A1 · M66: complete 31/32/33-point branches

The original target remains all finite simple six-uniform hypergraphs with at most 66 edges. The imported minimal-counterexample reduction gives pair-cover, exactly 66 edges, total degree 396 and minimum degree at least ceil((v−1)/5). This report establishes the complete v31, v32 and v33 branches. It does not claim the global target.

The probability engine is imported from propertyB_small_k/propertyB_m6_certificate.py, with its module constant explicitly reset to M=66. This is exact local finite verification, not an independent probability implementation. certificate.py generates every actual local type used below, together with its successful layout and exact upper bound. CERTIFICATE.json records the result. Root must independently verify this candidate and integrate it with the complete object domain.

A1 · Lemma 1: a stronger link bad-pair quota

Let F be a family of f distinct five-element sets on at most N points. Let G have these sets as vertices, adjacency meaning nonempty intersection, and q edges. Different connected components of G have disjoint supports.

For one component with t vertices and e edges, where t−1≤e≤C(t,2), define

a(t,e)=max(⌈t2t+2e⌉,⌈2t−e−12⌉).

Its independence number is at least a(t,e). The first term follows from the random-order independent-set expectation and Cauchy–Schwarz. For the second, fix a spanning tree. There are r=e−t+1 edges outside it. Delete at most one endpoint for each such edge, a total of at most r vertices. The remaining induced graph is a forest on at least t−r vertices, whose larger bipartition class is an independent set of size at least ceil((t−r)/2)=ceil((2t−e−1)/2). If this expression is nonpositive it is harmless.

Disjoint five-sets from an independent set imply component support at least 5a(t,e). A component with t≥2 also has support at least six, because its five-sets are distinct. A further valid strengthening is support at least eleven if

e<(t2)−⌊t2⌋.

Indeed, if the component support had at most ten points, any five-set would have at most one distinct disjoint partner: on fewer than ten points there is none, and on exactly ten points the only possible partner is its complement. Thus the nonedge graph would have maximum degree at most one and at most floor(t/2) edges, contradicting the displayed condition.

Write u(1,0)=5. For t≥2 let u(t,e) be the maximum of 6, 5a(t,e), and eleven when the last condition holds. Define recursively

S(0,q)=0,S(f,q)=min1≤t≤ft−1≤e≤min{q,(t2)}{u(t,e)+S(f−t,q−e)}.

Then the union of F has at least S(f,q) points. To prove this, select an actual component (t,e), apply its valid support bound, and apply induction to the remaining actual components, whose supports are disjoint. The recurrence permits component parameters without a realizing graph; this only lowers S, hence preserves its necessary-bound direction. It also permits unused budget q, as needed for an at-most-q assertion.

Consequently define

q∗(f,N)=min{q≥0:S(f,q)≤N}.

Then F has at least q_*(f,N) intersecting pairs. The implementation starts from the older valid ceiling bound ceil((5f−N)/4), truncated at zero; since that lower bound is valid, this does not skip a possible actual q. Its finite search terminates whenever a family F exists, and all parameter inputs used here admit an accepted relaxed component partition.

Applied to the actual link at a lock vertex, F consists of the original edges containing that vertex with the vertex removed. These five-sets are distinct because the original hypergraph is simple. Their support is at most v−1. Therefore q_*(d,v−1) can replace the old quota in the existing nonnegative capacity/weight deletion argument. For an avoided-lock subfamily the same conclusion uses f equal to its actual number of edges and N=v−1−|R|. The script diagnose.py exports support_min(f,q) and quota(N+1,f) for this purpose.

All three strengthening components above are used by the current candidate. In particular, the final two-point delta11 cases use the feedback-vertex bound and the unique-complement bound. The full table for f=0,…,24 and support N=28,…,32 is in CERTIFICATE.json. No claim of novelty is made for these elementary graph bounds.

A1 · Lemma 2: complete v31 selection

The minimum degree d lies in 6,…,12. For d≤11 choose a vertex of degree d and one lock; the six exact bounds are strict.

If d=12, at least seven vertices have degree exactly twelve: otherwise at least 25 vertices would have degree at least thirteen, forcing total degree at least 31·12+25=397>396. Fix a twelve-degree vertex x among them. Pair-cover gives

∑y≠x(λxy−1)=5⋅12−30=30.

If its six other twelve-degree partners all had codegree at least seven, the sum would be at least 36. Thus some second twelve-degree vertex y has 1≤λxy≤6. The complete trace multiplicities are

ℓxy=λ,ℓx=ℓy=12−λ,ℓ0=42+λ.

All six actual types have strict recorded bounds. Wider layouts are essential for λ=3 and λ=4; checking only central adjacent locks had missed these cases. This closes all v31 inputs.

A1 · Lemma 3: complete v32, minimum degree at most eleven

For a minimum-degree vertex x of degree d, there are at least

n=2(v−1)−5d

unit-codegree neighbors. This follows because the sum of λxy−1 is 5d−(v−1), and each nonunit neighbor contributes at least one. Here n>0 for d=7,…,11. If all unit neighbors had degree greater than

t=d+⌊396−vdn⌋,

the total degree would exceed vd+n(t+1−d)>396. Choose a unit neighbor y with degree e in d,…,t. certificate.py enumerates this entire necessary interval separately for each d, uses the unique two-lock trace, and obtains strict bounds for every such type. This closes v32,d≤11.

A1 · Lemma 4: complete v32, minimum degree twelve

Let R be the twelve-degree vertices. The total excess above twelve is twelve, so |R|≥20. All vertices outside R have degree at most 24. Each r∈R has at least two unit neighbors because its pair-excess is 29 among 31 partners.

If there is a unit pair inside R, its two-lock type (12,12,1) is strict. If there is a unit pair from R to a vertex of degree e∈{14,…,24}, the complete eleven-type two-lock certificate is strict. Hence assume every unit neighbor of every r∈R has degree thirteen. Let B be the set of these neighbors. Since each costs at least one of the twelve excess units, |B|≤12. The unit pairs between R and B form a bipartite graph with every r nonisolated.

Write u_r for r's degree in this bipartite graph and t_b for b's degree. Suppose there is no b-centered wedge r–b–r′ whose endpoint codegree is at most two. Then every such r′ has λrr′≥3. For every edge rb, all t_b−1 other R-neighbors of b are among these partners. Relative to baseline codegree two on all 31 partners of r, exactly u_r unit partners decrease its row sum by one each; the t_b−1 identified partners increase it by at least one each. Thus

60=∑z≠rλrz≥62−ur+tb−1,

so t_b≤u_r−1 and therefore 1/t_b>1/u_r. Summing over all bipartite edges gives

|B|=∑rb1tb>∑rb1ur=|R|,

contradicting |B|≤12<20≤|R|. Hence there is an actual wedge with center degree13, endpoints degree12, both center–endpoint codegrees one and endpoint codegree l∈{1,2}.

The triple intersection τ is zero or one. These four complete actual trace types are

ℓ123=τ,ℓ12=ℓ13=1−τ,ℓ23=l−τ,

ℓ1=11+τ,ℓ2=ℓ3=11−l+τ,ℓ0=66−∑T≠∅ℓT,

where vertex1 is the degree13 center. All four certificate bounds are strict. This closes v32,d12.

A1 · Lemma 5: complete v33 selection

The same actual minimum/unit-partner selection covers d=7,…,12. With the stronger link quota every two-lock type is strict except e14 at d9,d10,d11. In particular d12 is handled directly, and the earlier max-unit-degree wedge idea is unnecessary.

Here take y to be a minimum-degree unit neighbor of the minimum-degree x. If e=d(y)≠14, the corresponding passing type applies. In the exceptional three cases e=14, all unit neighbors of x have degree at least fourteen.

If d=9, x has at least 19 unit neighbors. The total excess above nine is 99. Nineteen vertices of degree at least fourteen cost at least 95 of those excess units; twenty would cost 100, so x has exactly nineteen unit neighbors. Its other thirteen partners are nonunit. Since

∑z≠x(λxz−1)=45−32=13,

every one of those thirteen partners has codegree exactly two with x. The nineteen unit neighbors leave only four excess degree units among the other fourteen vertices (including x), so at least ten vertices have degree nine. Thus another degree9 vertex y exists, is a nonunit partner, and has λxy=2. Its two-lock type has exact upper bound

101147/103385<1

at positions (16,18). This closes d9 entirely, including the previous failed three-lock λ=3 profiles.

If d=10 or d=11, let n=64−5d, respectively 14 or 9. The total excess above d is 396−33d, and n unit neighbors cost at least n(14−d). The respective remaining slacks are ten or six. Among at least n unit neighbors, therefore at least n−slack have degree exactly fourteen: respectively four or three. This count is still valid if there are more than n unit neighbors: each additional one costs at least 14−d≥3 extra units and cannot reduce the lower bound. More directly, if u≥n actual unit neighbors and h of them have degree above fourteen, then

u(14−d)+h≤396−33d,

so the number u−h of degree14 unit neighbors is at least (15−d)u−(396−33d)≥(15−d)n−(396−33d)=n−slack.

Choose two degree14 unit neighbors. Their mutual codegree l ranges from one to fourteen. Their triple intersection τ with x is zero or one; nonnegative single traces require 13−l+τ≥0. The actual trace multiplicities are

ℓ123=τ,ℓ12=ℓ13=1−τ,ℓ23=l−τ,

ℓ1=d−2+τ,ℓ2=ℓ3=13−l+τ,ℓ0=66−∑T≠∅ℓT.

For each d=10,11 the complete 27 actual (l,τ) types have strict bounds in the certificate. This closes v33.

certificate.py enumerates every necessary type in these selection branches, without enumeration of original hypergraphs. DIAGNOSTIC.json, FOUR.json and the exploratory files preserve failed older menus; those failed menus are not assumptions or components of the final proof.

A2 · 2. 最小单位伙伴为十二时的实际双臂选点

A4 · 34点：最小度十一

A4 · 34点、最小度十一的完整分支候选

结论。 固定有限简单六元超图 H=(V,E)，假设 |V|=34、|E|=66、每个点对被某条边覆盖且最小度为十一。下述实际选点分流覆盖全部此类超图。九个必要局部型均有严格小于一的精确失败概率上界，两套既有概率实现给出逐项相同的有理数。因此，在既有条件排列／随机贪心失败上界定理和已证明的 component 配额引理下，这一完整分支可二染。

这不是完整 m(6)≥67 的验收；本文没有处理其他点数／最小度，没有 Lean 或指定跨家族审阅。当前状态为 same-family / provisional，等待主代理核读和全局装配。

A4 · 1. 预算与辅助图

记 d(x) 为实际度数，λxy 为实际共度。总度为 396。定义 R={x:d(x)=11},r=|R|,A={x:d(x)∈{12,13}},a=|A|, C={x:d(x)≥14},c=|C|,b=a+c=34−r. 相对每点十一的总度超额为 396−34⋅11=22，所以 (1)r≥12,b≤22,a+3c≤22,c≤7.

若 R 内有共度一的点对，直接使用第4节的双锁型。以下假设 R 内任意不同两点的共度均至少二。

对每个 x∈R，其共度总和为 5d(x)=55，故 ∑y≠x(λxy−1)=55−33=22. 在33个伙伴中，至多22个共度大于一。因此 x 至少有11个单位共度伙伴；由当前假设它们全部位于 A∪C。设其实际单位伙伴数为 ux，则 (2)11≤ux≤b. 特别地，因 c≤7，每个 x∈R 在 A 中至少有四个单位伙伴，故 a>0。

A4 · 2. 低中心楔形或唯一刚性结构

引理34.11.1。 在上述假设下，至少有以下一种实际结构：

  1. z∈A，x,y∈R 为不同点，λzx=λzy=1、λxy=2；
  2. r=12，其余22个点的度数全为十二，R 与其余点之间全部共度一，且 R 内全部共度三。

证明。 在 R 与 A 之间按共度一连二分图；对 z∈A 记其在该图的度为 tz，只在 tz>0 时使用倒数。假设第一种结构不存在，则同一个 z 的任意两个 R 邻点的共度至少三，因为 R 内已无共度一的点对。

固定单位边 xz。基线为 x 到33个伙伴的共度各二；其恰好 ux 个单位伙伴各使该基线减一；z 的另 tz−1 个 R 邻点又各至少增加一。因此 (3)55=∑w≠xλxw≥66−ux+tz−1,tz≤ux−10. 记 A+={z∈A:tz>0}，a+=|A+|≤a。由 (2)，ux−10>0。对全部实际单位边求和，得到 (4)a≥a+=∑xz1tz≥∑x∈R|N(x)∩A|ux−10≥∑x∈Rux−cux−10. 这里仅对真实二分图的边求和；A 中可能存在孤立点，因此第一步使用 a≥a+，并未将孤立点当作正度点。

因为 ux≤b、c≤7<10，逐项有 ux−cux−10−b−cb−10=(10−c)(b−ux)(ux−10)(b−10)≥0. 又 b−c=a，故 (4) 给 a≥rab−10. 由 a>0 得 b−10≥r=34−b，即 b≥22。结合 (1)，只能 b=22,r=12；由于总度超额恰为22，其余22个点的度数全部为十二，故 a=22,c=0。

此时 (4) 及其后的界首尾相等。由于 10−c=10>0，上面的差式迫使每个 ux=b=22。所以 R 与全部其余点之间均共度一。固定任一其余点，它与全部12个 R 点构成单位边，故不存在第一种结构意味着 R 中任意两点共度至少三。对 x∈R，外部共度之和是22，剩余11个 R 伙伴的共度之和为 55−22=33；每项至少三，因此每项恰为三，得到第二种结构。◻

这个论证不要求事先选定某个最小度点的最小单位伙伴，也不要求所有高于十一的点具有相同度数。

A4 · 3. 刚性结构的实际四锁选择与完整迹

引理34.11.2。 在引理34.11.1的第二种结构中，可以选三名 R 点 x0,x1,x2 和一名度十二的外点 z，使三名 R 点两两共度三，z 到它们分别共度一，且没有原边同时包含 z 和其中两名 R 点。

证明。 固定任一外点 z。因其与每名 R 点的共度恰一，经过 z 的十二条边将12个 R 点按其唯一共边分成若干不相交的非空组，每组至多五点。一组或两组至多容纳十点，所以至少三组非空。分别取不同三组的一点，即得所需三点。◻

A5 · 35点：最小度九

A5 · 35 vertices, minimum degree nine: a complete candidate

Let H be the same simple six-uniform pair-covering hypergraph, with v=35,M=66, degree sum396 and actual minimum degree9. The existing adaptive certificate closes the case where a minimum-degree vertex x has a unit-codegree neighbor of degree at most11. Thus fix x of degree9 and assume every member of A={z:lambda(x,z)=1} has degree at least12. Put u=|A|. The x row gives u≥23, while the total excess above degree9 is81, so3u≤81 and u≤27.

A5 · Lemma: a low nonunit partner of codegree two exists

There are n=34−u nonunit partners of x. Their total sum of lambda(x,z)−1 is11. Let l be the number with lambda exactly two. The other n−l partners each contribute at least two, so11≥l+2(n−l), or l≥57−2u.

If all these l partners had degree at least11, their degree excess above9, together with A, would be at least

3u+2l≥114−u≥87>81,

contradiction. Hence an actual y outside A∪{x} has degree e∈{9,10} and lambda(x,y)=2.

A5 · Lemma: an actual low common unit neighbor exists

The number of nonunit partners of y is at most5e−34. One of them is x, which does not belong to A. Thus the common unit pool C=A∩{z:lambda(y,z)=1} has size

|C|≥u−(5e−35)=u+35−5e.

All A vertices have degree at least12. After charging3u excess units to A and e−9 units to y, the remaining degree excess is at most81−3u−(e−9). Therefore C contains z of degree at most

12+floor((81−3u−(e−9))/(u+35−5e)).

If e=9, u≥23 makes the numerator at most12 and denominator at least13; hence d(z)=12. If e=10, numerator at most11 and denominator at least8, so d(z)≤13 (and at least12). The denominator is positive in both cases. The three selected vertices are distinct; their codegrees are lambda(z,x)=lambda(z,y)=1, lambda(x,y)=2.

A5 · Complete actual traces and arithmetic

Label z as0, x as1, y as2. The only degree triples are (12,9,9), (12,9,10), (13,9,10). Let tau∈{0,1} be the actual triple intersection multiplicity. Their complete trace counts are

ell7=tau,ell3=ell5=1−tau,ell6=2−tau, ell1=d(z)−2+tau,ell2=6+tau,ell4=e−3+tau, ell0=66−sumT≠0ellT.

All six complete local types have a strict conditional failure bound using the proven component quota separately for each avoided pool, taking the maximum valid deduction against the same actual bad-pair vector. The submitted exact values and layouts are in LOW_PAIR_CENTER35.json, produced by low_pair_center35.py using component_kernel.py. The largest submitted value is14882237/14887440<1. Together with the imported adaptive cases e≤11 this covers the entire v35, minimum-degree9 branch.

Status: primary-agent paper derivation and exact arithmetic; independent replay and cross-family review pending. This is one internal branch, not the whole m(6)≥67 theorem.

A6 · 35点：最小度十

A6 · 35 vertices, minimum degree ten: complete candidate

Theorem. Every finite simple six-uniform pair-covering hypergraph with exactly 66 edges, 35 vertices, and actual minimum degree ten is two-colorable.

Status. Complete computer-assisted proof candidate. Independent replay and cross-family review of this final branch are pending. This proof uses the same exact conditional permutation failure mechanism and valid bad-pair deletion imported in PROOF36_38.md. It adds no assumption to the original Property B target: pair coverage and the vertex/degree case are internal counterexample branches.

Let H be this same actual hypergraph. Write d(x) and λxy for its actual degrees and codegrees. Then

(1)∑xd(x)=396,d(x)≥10,∑y≠x(λxy−1)=5d(x)−34.

The total degree excess above ten is 396−35⋅10=46. Every degree-ten vertex has at most sixteen nonunit partners, and hence at least eighteen unit-codegree neighbors.

A6 · 1. Complete accepted numerical configurations

CERT35_MIN10.json contains only the 102 successful records used in this proof; finalize_min10_35.py extracts them from the actual completed calculations and fixes their successful labels, positions, multiplicities and exact rational bounds. These are three complete input domains.

A. A unit pair of degree-ten vertices. Suppose x,y both have degree ten and λxy=1. The unit neighbors of x other than y number at least seventeen, whereas y has at most sixteen nonunit partners. Thus some actual z has λxz=λyz=1. Its degree f lies in [10,56] by the total degree sum. The actual unit triple has one of the two usual complete trace patterns. Nonnegative empty-trace multiplicity imposes f≤49 in the separate-edge pattern, and f≤48 in the one-triple-edge pattern. Thus precisely 40+39=79 necessary nonnegative degree/trace types remain. All have strict failure bounds, extracted from ADAPTIVE_COMPONENT.json. The broader historical generator also recorded fifteen negative-multiplicity tuples; they are impossible actual inputs and are excluded from the final certificate.

B. A degree-ten vertex with two degree-eleven unit neighbors. Here the degrees are (10,11,11), the two codegrees incident to the degree-ten point are one, the other codegree λ ranges from one to eleven, and the triple intersection multiplicity τ is zero or one. Exactly 21 of these tuples have nonnegative actual trace multiplicities; the excluded tuple λ=11,τ=0 would require a negative singleton multiplicity. All 21 have strict bounds in TWO_ARMS35.json and are copied into the final certificate.

C. A degree-twelve common unit center of a codegree-two pair of degree-ten points. Label the degree-twelve center as zero and the degree-ten points as one and two. The codegrees are λ01=λ02=1, λ12=2. There are exactly two actual trace patterns, indexed by τ∈{0,1}:

ℓ7=τ,ℓ3=ℓ5=1−τ,ℓ6=2−τ,

ℓ1=10+τ,ℓ2=ℓ4=7+τ,ℓ0=38−τ.

The actual completed calculation LOW_PAIR_MIN10_35.json gives

τ=0:U=185588/186093<1,p=(17,18,19),

τ=1:U=1644827/1654160<1,p=(17,16,18).

The lock positions are indexed by the stated labels. These two rows also appear in the final certificate. Each strict configuration produces an actual coloring, regardless of how those actual locks were selected.

A6 · 2. Low codegree-two partner

Assume for contradiction that H is not two-colorable. Domain A implies that no degree-ten point has a degree-ten unit neighbor. Domain B implies that no degree-ten point has two degree-eleven unit neighbors.

Fix any degree-ten point x and let A be its unit-neighbor set, of size u. Then u≥18. Every member of A has degree at least eleven and at most one has degree eleven. Therefore the degree excess contributed by A is at least 2u−1. Since the entire excess is 46,

18≤u≤23.

Let l be the number of actual partners y with λxy=2. There are 34−u nonunit partners in total. The other 34−u−l partners have codegree at least three. By the exact row excess in (1),

(2)16≥l+2(34−u−l),l≥52−2u.

If all these l partners had degree at least eleven, their contribution to the degree excess, together with that of the disjoint set A, would be at least

(2u−1)+l≥(2u−1)+(52−2u)=51>46,

contradiction. Hence there is an actual degree-ten point y satisfying λxy=2.

A6 · 3. An actual degree-twelve common unit center

Let P={z:d(z)≥12} and write c=|P|. Every degree-ten point has at least eighteen unit neighbors, none of degree ten and at most one of degree eleven. Thus it has at least seventeen unit neighbors inside P. In particular c≥17. Each member of P contributes at least two units of the total excess, so c≤23.

The actual degree-ten points x,y from §2 therefore have at least

17+17−c=34−c≥11

common unit neighbors in P. Suppose all those common neighbors had degree at least thirteen. Their additional excess beyond twelve is at least 34−c. Counting the baseline excess two from every member of P would then give

46≥2c+(34−c)=c+34≥51,

contradiction. Hence there is an actual common unit neighbor z of degree exactly twelve. It satisfies

d(z)=12,d(x)=d(y)=10,λzx=λzy=1,λxy=2.

This is precisely accepted numerical domain C. It gives an actual valid coloring of H, contradicting the assumption. Therefore the theorem holds. ∎

A6 · Reproducibility and scope

The exact final certificate has 79+21+2=102 rows, all with nonnegative actual multiplicities and strict rational upper bounds. Each row records the deletion method it actually used: the first group uses the common integer avoided-subset vector with the previously proved component-support quota; the other groups use the maximum of the valid single-subset component-quota deductions. Neither method adds overlapping deductions.

finalize_min10_35.py regenerates the final certificate from the completed source JSON files. The probability kernel is reused from the project; this is not an independent implementation. The final proof uses none of the non-strict or interrupted fourth-lock exploratory domains documented in STATUS35.md.

396≥11r+12(35−r)=420−r,

so r≥24. A point x∈R has at most 55−34=21 nonunit neighbors. Thus it has a unit neighbor y∈R because r−1−21≥2. For the specified actual unit edge xy, the fixed-edge weak-wedge lemma in PROOF36_38.md applies:

5(d(x)+d(y))=110<2⋅35+2⋅24−6=112.

A8 · 36–38点：完整实际分支

A8 · Complete conditional closure at 36,37,38 vertices

A8 · Theorem and imports

Theorem. Every finite simple six-uniform pair-covering hypergraph with exactly 66 edges and v∈{36,37,38} is two-colorable.

Status. Complete computer-assisted proof candidate, conditional only on the explicitly imported probability mechanism below; independent numerical verification pending. This closes these three internal vertex branches of the original m(6)≥67 target. It does not by itself prove that full target.

Write d(x) and λxy for actual degrees and codegrees of this same hypergraph. Pair coverage gives

(1)∑xd(x)=396,d(x)≥⌈(v−1)/5⌉,∑y≠x(λxy−1)=5d(x)−(v−1).

The imported conditional random-greedy failure bound, exact endpoint and ordered-pair weights, valid bad-pair deletion, and full actual edge-trace recovery are those in context/propertyb-m6-66-20261029/PROOF_M6_GE66.md, §§3–4, with the budget 65 replaced by 66. Both actual three-unit-lock patterns must be retained. A strict conditional failure bound below one produces an actual successful ordering and hence a valid coloring of the original hypergraph.

REPORT.md, Lemma 1, proves the successive minimum-unit-neighbor selection used below. Its statement and proof are part of this package. The component-support quota and avoided-subset joint vector used in ADAPTIVE_COMPONENT.json are explained and proved there. Their use is a valid strengthening of the original probability bound. The four-lock calculations use the weaker, cheaper deduction maxRDR, where each DR is the least possible bad-pair weight within that one avoided-subset pool. Taking a maximum is valid because the actual bad-pair weight is at least each DR; the deductions are never added.

A8 · Lemma 2: a weak wedge through one specified actual unit edge

Let R be an actual vertex subset of size r, and let a,b∈R satisfy λab=1. If

(2)5(d(a)+d(b))<2v+2r−6,

then there exists z∈R∖{a,b} such that either

λaz=1,λbz≤2,orλbz=1,λaz≤2.

Thus the three actual locks have either all three codegrees one, or exactly one codegree two and the other two one.

Proof. For x∈R, let ux be the number of its unit-codegree neighbors in R. Suppose no such z exists. Each unit neighbor of b other than a then has codegree at least three with a. None of these vertices is a unit neighbor of a. Counting all r−1 row entries with baseline two, subtracting one for the ua unit entries and adding one for the ub−1 specified entries, gives

∑z∈R∖{a}λaz≥2(r−1)−ua+(ub−1).

Every vertex outside R has codegree at least one with a. Using (1), the left side is at most 5d(a)−(v−r). Therefore

ub−ua≤5d(a)−v−r+3.

Interchanging a,b gives the reverse inequality with d(b). Adding contradicts (2). ∎

A8 · Lemma 3: an additional lock with total codegree excess at most one

Let S be three actual locks, with degree sum T, and let

L=∑{x,y}⊂S(λxy−1),E=5T−3(v−1)−2L,n=v−3.

Then at least

(3)p=n−⌊E/2⌋

outside vertices w satisfy ∑x∈S(λxw−1)≤1. If p>0 and the actual minimum degree is δ, one such w has degree

(4)δ≤d(w)≤D:=δ+⌊396−T−nδp⌋.

Proof. Sum the three rows in (1), and remove their internal terms. Every internal excess is counted twice, leaving exactly E as the nonnegative sum of codegree excesses from S to its complement. At most ⌊E/2⌋ outside vertices have excess at least two, proving (3). The sum of degree excess over δ on all outside vertices is 396−T−nδ. Among at least p eligible vertices, one has excess at most its quotient by p, proving (4). The fourth lock has all three new codegrees one, or one new codegree two and the other two one. ∎

A8 · Lemma 4: complete actual trace generation

For four labelled locks, let λij be their six actual codegrees. Every original edge with at least two selected locks gives a clique block B⊆{0,1,2,3}. The block multiset satisfies

∑B⊇{i,j}mB=λij(i<j),mB∈N.

Conversely, all nonnegative solutions are generated by the function parts(target) in four_repair.py. It orders the eleven possible blocks (six pairs, four triples, one quadruple), recursively removes one block only when all its pair capacities are still positive, and allows repetition of the same block. The sorted-index restriction selects one order for every multiset. Every nonempty target solution contains some allowable block, and induction on the total remaining pair capacity proves completeness.

The restriction B↦B∩{0,1,2} must equal the already known parent-triple block multiset; the scripts enforce this equality. Thus the fourth-lock computation preserves, and does not forget, the actual parent trace. For given four degrees and blocks, the singleton multiplicity at lock i is di−∑B∋imB and the empty multiplicity is 66 minus all nonempty multiplicities. Every actual hypergraph has nonnegative multiplicities, so negative tuples may be discarded.

A9 · 39点：弱四锁分支

A9 · M66：39点完整纸面分支候选

本节固定同一实际有限简单六元超图H，恰66边、39点、点对覆盖、总度396。点对覆盖给最低度至少8。沿用上层条件排列失败概率公式，并用PROOF40_41.md§2的同一实际坏对向量最大避点配额扣除；本文不增加原目标的假设。

A9 · 引理1：实际弱四锁的选择

存在三个两两共度1的锁x0,x1,x2，每点度数在8…10。设其度数和为t。还能选第四个不同锁y，使其度数在8…D(t)，且它到原三锁的三个共度均为1，或恰有一个共度为2、另两个为1。其中

E(t)=5t−114,p(t)=36−floor(E(t)/2),D(t)=8+floor((108−t)/p(t))

具体为t24,25,26时D10；t27,28,29时D11；t30时D12。

证明：前三锁存在性由整数Q引理在v39、D10给Z33,Q16，33>2·16。对每个S外点y，令 e_y=Σ_{x∈S}(λxy−1)，点对覆盖给e_y≥0。前三锁两两共度1，故

∑y∉Sey=5t−2⋅3−3⋅36=5t−114=E(t)

于是至多floor(E(t)/2)名外点有e_y≥2；至少p(t)名有e_y≤1。外点的总度数超出最低度8的部分为396−t−36·8=108−t。若这至少p(t)名点的度数全部大于D(t)，超额就严格大于108−t，矛盾。因此其中有y度数至多D(t)。整数非负的三个λxy−1之和至多1，给所述共度型。∎

A9 · 引理2：完整实际迹分类

将前三锁按度数排列并标为0、1、2，第四锁标为3。任一至少二点迹消耗其包含的全部点对共度单位。引理1给完整K4的六个点对各有一个单位，并允许(0,3)、(1,3)、(2,3)中恰一个点对再有一个单位。至少三点迹的重数不可能超过1，因为其中含有原三锁中的点对，或至少两个到原锁的共度1点对；唯一可重复的至少二点迹就是被加倍的二点迹本身。

因此实际至少二点迹完全对应于上述六维点对重数向量的多重团分解：全单位型有6个带标签分解；每个指定加倍点对各有7个。parts(target,idx)按非递减团序递归扣除一个团的各点对单位，当且仅当余向量为零时接收。这枚举每个多重团分解恰一次，覆盖全部实际情况；无整图枚举。剩余单点迹重数由实际度数减去已经列出的含点迹重数决定，空迹为66减去总数。

A9 · 定理：39点分支可二染

引理1允许前三度数的全部非递减三元组8…10。对每组，以D(t)作为第四度数完整上限，逐项取第四度数8…D(t)，并列引理2的6+3·7=27种多重团分解，共999个必要局部型。每型的所有实际迹重数均已确定。

对999型，使用同一实际坏对向量最大避点配额扣除后，全有严格失败概率上界小于1，详见CERT39.json。每行保存前三／第四度数、加倍点对、实际多重迹、迹重数、条件排列布局和精确有理上界。初次使用七种连续四锁布局时965型严格，剩余34型在把加倍点对置于四个连续位置两端后全部严格。最大最终界为113467943/113476275<1。

这些布局允许锁的标签在排列中以任意顺序出现；概率核接收positions[j]作为锁j的位置。将加倍点对放在两端只是选择另一个合法条件排列，不改变实际超图、迹或坏对对象。

由原条件排列／贪心失败上界，严格小于1给至少一个成功二染色。因此本节覆盖完整39点实际分支。∎

A9 · 复现与范围

先运行python3 context/propertyb-m6-67-progress-20261029/tail39_41/weak_four39.py，再运行同目录weak_repair39.py。初次999型17.208 CPU秒，34型修复0.706 CPU秒，共17.914 CPU秒。CERT39.json合并两次的成功行；原始失败保留于WEAK_FOUR39.json，但已由WEAK_REPAIR39.json逐项严格替代。

计算复用原条件排列权重。它是实际精确运行，并非独立第二实现；本分支仍待主代理核验、独立算术及全目标整合，不把局部候选升级为完整m(6)≥67结果。

A10 · 40–41点：重选锁与完整分流

A10 · M66：40、41点完整纸面分支候选

令 H 是同一实际有限简单六元超图，恰66边、点对覆盖，总度396。本文只处理 v=40、41；这些条件来自上层最小反例归约，而非原目标附加假设。度数下界均为8。冲突图以共度至少2连边，故每点 x 的冲突度至多 5d(x)−(v−1)。独立锁集因此两两共度恰1。本文复用上层条件排列概率及其端点／单交边对计数；没有新Lean结论。

A10 · 1. 选锁及完整迹

对 L={x:d(x)≤10}，∑L(11−d(x))≥11v−396。整数Q选锁引理在 v40 给 Z44,Q14，44>3·14；在v41给Z55,Q12，55>4·12。因此分别存在四、五个度在8…10的实际单位锁。将它们按度数排序，再按此标签记录所有至少两点迹。共度恰1意味着这些迹的二点集恰好划分完整K4或K5的全部点对，每个迹恰有一条原边，故代码的全部6或32种带标签团划分是完整域。每个单点迹重数是该点度数减去含它的团数，空迹为66减去其余重数。

A10 · 2. 同一坏对向量上的避点配额

固定锁j及其条件位置h。对每个 R⊆S∖{j}，取经过j而避开R的实际边，其数为 f_R。删去j后的五元链接位于最多 v−1−|R| 点上。若其中相交无序边对数为 B_R，则由链接简单性，两条不同链接交集至多4，

5fR≤v−1−|R|+4BR

从而 qR=max(0,ceil((5fR−v+1+|R|)/4))≤BR。

所有R使用同一个实际坏对计数向量 z_{T,U}，其坐标是同时含j的无序迹型格，容量是 binom(ell_T,2) 或 ell_T ell_U，非负权 w_{T,U} 为两种有向条件排列权重之和。给定R，把所有满足(T∪U)∩R=∅的格按权重递增填满q_R个单位，所得 D_{j,R} 是该单项配额下的精确最小成本，故不超过实际坏对总权。令 Dj=maxRDj,R，仍不超过同一实际总权。这里取最大值，绝不把不同R的配额成本相加。空R正是原完整池扣除，故只会加强原上界。

于是失败概率至多 ∑hmin(Ah,Bh,Qh−Dh)，非锁点D_h=0。kernel.py实现此式，所有比较为Fraction。

A10 · 3. 排除40点唯一失败迹

完整90型中，只有度数(8,8,8,10)、四锁同在一条原边E的型不严格。设其中三名八度锁为a,b,c。每名八度点冲突度至多1。L至少ceil(44/3)=15点，故E外至少9名L点；三名八度点总共至多3个冲突邻点。可取y∈L\E，与a,b,c均共度1。新四锁a,b,c,y不能同在一条原边F：a,b在E中的共边唯一，若F含它们则F=E，但y∉E。因此重选后仍属于同一完整90型域，并已排除唯一失败型。所有其他型的确切布局和严格有理界见证书。

A10 · 4. 排除41点所需的五点同边迹

可进一步要求：五个锁若同在一条边E，则其度数总和t必须为50。

证明：若原五锁S位于E且t≤49，首先，若有八度点y∉E，由于其冲突度至多0，它与任意四名S点构成新五个单位锁，且不全在一条原边内。否则E外的L点度数均为9或10。S的总低度权为55−t，E的第六点低度权至多3；故E外L点低度权至少55−(55−t)−3=t−3，每点权至多2，所以其人数至少ceil((t−3)/2)。S到外部的冲突关联总数至多Σ_{x∈S}(5d(x)−40)=5t−200。对40≤t≤49，

2ceil((t−3)/2)>5t−200

因此有E外低度点y至多与S中一人冲突，取四名非邻点加y。新五锁两两共度1，并不能同在一条原边：所选四名原锁中任一对的唯一共边是E。这个重选同时排除所有t≤49的五点同边迹。t=50的单一型由概率证书严格处理。∎

完整672型的概率表中，所有非严格型均是t≤49的五点同边迹，故全部由该结构重选覆盖。所有非五点同边迹均严格，不依赖度数和。

A10 · 5. 精确证书和结论

执行 python3 context/propertyb-m6-67-progress-20261029/tail39_41/cert40_41.py。CERT40_41.json保存90+672型的实际迹重数、成功／最佳布局、精确概率界及结构排除标识。完整运行实际CPU约25.303秒；无未闭型。脚本复用原概率原语，尚不是第二实现或独立核验。原始五锁试算和残余最大配额试算分别保留为FIVE41.json和QUOTA_PROBE.json。

由上层实际概率判据，这给出v40、41两支的完整纸面候选。它不单独证明m(6)≥67；原始全域其余分支仍由主代理整合。

A11 · 42–44点：尾部锁选择及完整迹

A11 · Tail lock-selection review: 42, 43 and 44 vertices

PASS (same-family / provisional). The proposed structural selection arguments are valid. They remove every failing pattern recorded in ../pilot/FIVE.json at v=42,43,44, assuming its probability bounds are correct. This review reads those existing rational results and checks their classification/strictness; it does not independently recompute the probability formula, run a new probability table, or close m(6)≥67.

Throughout, H is a finite simple pair-covering six-uniform hypergraph, with at most 66 edges and hence total degree at most 396. Write λxy for actual codegree. For v∈{42,43,44}, pair coverage implies 5d(x)=∑y≠xλxy≥v−1, so every degree is at least nine. Put L={x:d(x)=9} and r=|L|. The degree budget gives 396≥9r+10(v−r)=10v−r,r≥10v−396. On L, join distinct vertices in the conflict graph G when their codegree is at least two. Then degG⁡(x)≤∑y≠x(λxy−1)=45−(v−1)=46−v. A greedy independent set therefore has size at least ⌈r/(47−v)⌉. Every independent set in G consists of actual degree-nine vertices with all pairwise codegrees exactly one. Thus the guaranteed independent-set sizes at v=42,43,44 are respectively 5, 9 and 15. At v=44, every vertex has degree nine because 9⋅44=396 already exhausts the budget.

Lemma A (42 vertices: exclude a common five-point trace). There are five degree-nine unit-codegree locks not contained together in any hyperedge.

Proof. Choose an independent five-set S⊆L, which exists because r≥24 and Δ(G)≤4. If no edge contains S, the result already holds. Otherwise fix E∈H containing S. Since |E|=6, |L∖E|≥24−6=18. There are at most ∑x∈SdegG⁡(x)≤20 conflict incidences between S and L∖E. If every vertex of L∖E had at least two neighbors in S, there would be at least 36 such incidences, a contradiction. Choose y∈L∖E with at most one neighbor in S, and choose four vertices A⊆S not adjacent to y. Then T=A∪{y} is independent. If an edge F contained T, any two vertices of A would lie in both E and F. Their codegree is one, so F=E, contradicting y∉E. Therefore T has the required property. ◻

Lemma B (nine unit-codegree vertices: exclude every trace of size four or five). If S0 is a set of nine vertices with pairwise codegrees one, there is a five-set T⊆S0 with |F∩T|≤3 for every hyperedge F.

Proof. If every edge already meets S0 in at most three vertices, choose any five of its vertices. Otherwise choose an edge E with |E∩S0|≥4. Since |E|=6, there are at least three vertices in S0∖E. Choose three vertices A⊆E∩S0 and two vertices B⊆S0∖E, and put T=A∪B. The edge E meets T in exactly three vertices. For any other edge F≠E, one has |F∩E∩S0|≤1: two such vertices would have at least two common edges, contradicting unit codegree. Therefore |F∩T|≤|F∩A|+|F∩B|≤1+2=3. This proves the lemma. ◻

At v=43, the independent-set bound supplies nine degree-nine vertices, so Lemma B applies. At v=44, it supplies at least fifteen; take any nine and apply Lemma B. All selected vertices retain degree nine and unit pairwise codegree.

A11 · Exact correspondence with the existing table

For a labelled five-lock set, a multi-lock trace is encoded by a mask in {1,…,31} with at least two set bits. Unit codegree means the clique edge sets associated with these masks form an exact partition of the ten pairs of five labels. Conversely every such partition is a necessary trace pattern; singleton counts are recovered from degree nine and the empty count from the 66-edge budget. Extra global realizability conditions would only remove patterns and are unnecessary for this coverage argument.

A separate short recursive exact-pair-cover calculation rebuilt all 32 labelled partitions and confirmed equality with the 32 distinct masks lists at each of the three vertex counts. This was a classification check, not a new probability calculation. Every stored strict flag was checked against Fraction(U)<1.

The stored non-strict rows are exactly:

42[31]2607524/2561251
43[31]2607524/2561251

Mask 31 is a five-point trace, excluded by Lemma A and Lemma B. Mask 27 has four set bits; the other four masks pair the omitted label with the four labels in 27. Thus the second v=44 failure is exactly a four-point trace plus its remaining four pairs. Lemma B excludes it, along with all five possible labelled four-point trace patterns. Only one of these five four-point patterns failed in this particular table; excluding all five is a valid stronger structural restriction and avoids relying on positional symmetry.

Scope of acceptance. Both short structural lemmas and their application to the recorded tail patterns pass. This justifies the proposed v=42,43,44 repair conditional on the existing certificate formula and table calculation. The task's remaining 31…41 domain is not addressed; no full new lower bound, Lean proof, or cross-family approval is claimed.
